eps.d: The Ant Hill Mob escapes a pursuing policeman by donning disguises as the Seven Dwarfs.
The Wacky Racers encounter ghosts in the abandoned town of Spookane.
Dick Dastardly tries to win Chief Crazy Buffalo's friendship by warning him of the approaching "iron wagons."

eps.t: Beat the Clock to Yellow Rock
eps.d: Dastardly attempts to disguise the Old Unfaithful geyser as part of the road.
Dastardly discovers an irate Hillbilly determined to protect his land from trespassers--including the Wacky Racers!
Dastardly dresses as Little Red Riding Hood and tricks Penelope into stopping at Granny's house to deliver a basket of treats.
In Mexico, Dick Dastardly and Muttley try to slow the other drivers by using a herd of cow-shaped balloons to block the road.
Dick Dastardly hypnotizes a giant gorilla in an attempt to win the race.
The Ant Hill mob escapes the police by posing as Wood Scouts.
Dick Dastardly uses heavy machinery at a road construction site to stop the Wacky Racers.

eps.t: By Roller Coaster to Upsan Downs
eps.d: The wacky racers travel by rollercoaster to Upsan Downs when Dick Dastardly diverts them into a closed amusement park for a spin on some of the rides.
Dastardly diverts the Surplus Special onto the site of an army war games.
Dastardly diverts the rest of the racers onto a Mississippi riverboat.
Dastardly tricks several racers into searching for a "harmless" gorilla, who is actually Dastardly in disguise, at a wild animal park.
Dishonest Dick Dastardly steals a police car and chases the Ant Hill Mob into a boys' baseball game.
In Oregon's rugged lumber country, Dick Dastardly tries to use falling trees and spinning saw blades to stop his opponents.
Devious Dick Dastardly diverts the Bouldermobile onto a construction site and the other cars follow it up the girders of a skyscraper.
On a trans-Canadian race, the Ant Hill Mob meets the Abominable Snowman.
To prevent Penelope from coming in first place, Dastardly creates a roadside beauty parlor to lure her into stopping.
The Wacky Racers are once again beset by Dick Dastardly's deviously dirty tricks as they travel to Grease Gun, Texas.
When the Ant Hill Mob zooms past Dick Dastardly, he directs a police officer to chase them.
Dick Dastardly discovers a genie in a bottle, but the well-meaning spirit misinterprets each request that Dastardly makes.
Dick Dastardly plots to have an aquarium whale swallow the rest of the contestants!
Dastardly and Muttly unleash a squadron of mechanical mosquitos to wreak havoc on the other cars.
A wanted poster inspires Dastardly to disguise himself as a bandit.
Dastardly plots to cover the roadway with icing and send Peter and Penelope spinning into a cake-making machine.
On the set of a medieval-themed movie, Dastardly attempts to trap the racers with the castle gate and drawbridge.
Dirty Dick Dastardly uses floor wax to slide the other cars into MacDonald's farm.
Dick Dastardly causes flat tires with a box of tacks on a jaunt to Ballpoint, Pennsylvania.
Outside the town of Law 'n Order, Dastardly changes the posted speed limit sign from 35 to 85 to create a Fast Track to Hackensack.
After causing an avalanche, Dastardly uses a ski jump for his own getaway, but the other cars follow him.
On a race from Key Largo to Key West, the racers must cross the famous series of bridges that connect the Florida Keys.
Dastardly hopes to exterminate the Ant Hill Mob by dressing Muttley in gangster garb to infiltrate the Bulletproof Bomb.
The drivers become lost in the tunnels of Carlsbad Caverns.
